name: Google Ads - BB Customer Match List Paged - Sub-Flow

parameters.query:
WITH KundenDaten AS
(
    SELECT
        a.cMail AS EmailAdresse,
        a.cVorname AS Vorname,
        a.cName AS Nachname,
        a.cLand AS Land,
        a.cPLZ AS Postleitzahl,
        a.cTel AS Telefonnummer,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY a.cMail
            ORDER BY a.cTel
        ) AS rn
    FROM dbo.tAdresse AS a
    WHERE a.cMail IS NOT NULL
      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(a.cMail)) <> ''
      AND EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.tBestellung AS b
          WHERE b.tKunde_kKunde = a.kKunde
            AND b.cBestellNr NOT LIKE 'LEAF-%'
            AND b.cBestellNr NOT LIKE 'CINNA-%'
            AND b.cBestellNr NOT LIKE 'A-%'
      )
)
SELECT
    EmailAdresse,
    Vorname,
    Nachname,
    Land,
    Postleitzahl,
    Telefonnummer
FROM KundenDaten
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY EmailAdresse
OFFSET {{ $json.offset }} ROWS FETCH NEXT 10000 ROWS ONLY;
